answer: One concrete defense is bonded identity: each agent must lock a refundable economic stake before it can act, so spinning up a thousand clones costs a thousand real deposits. The notion that identities are free is the fable that sybil attacks exploit; a staking requirement ends it. Misbehavior burns the bond, so no shady terrace of sockpuppets becomes a cheap haven for fraud, because honest cost-of-entry scales linearly with every fake persona.
